summary.decision: Proceed with a single multi-organism audit batch: Proteus mirabilis, Enterococcus faecium, Enterococcus faecalis, and the hospital-environment chlorhexidine preprint. Treat Pseudomonas, food-drain, and Staphylococcus datasets as small external-case candidates unless row counts and accession linkage are better than expected. Do not start training until a candidate has row-level labels plus public genome accessions.

studies.organism_role: catheter-associated urinary pathogen; healthcare wet-environment relevance
studies.endpoint: Chlorhexidine and other cationic biocide tolerance
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Article states all clinical metadata and accession numbers are included in Table S1; phenotype focus is cationic biocide tolerance.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: Raw reads generated under PRJNA1154625; previous PR00XXX reads under PRJNA475751; reference HI4320 under PRJNA12624.
studies.next_action: Extract Table S1 and verify whether each isolate has a CHX/cationic biocide phenotype plus SRA/BioSample accession.
studies.caution: Do not assume Table S1 contains every MIC endpoint until supplement extraction is verified.

studies.citation_short: García-Solache et al. 2019, Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy
studies.organism_role: nosocomial pathogen; VRE and hospital disinfectant relevance
studies.endpoint: Chlorhexidine MIC distribution and CHX-tolerance operon signature
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Paper reports MIC_CHX distribution for 106 isolates from diverse sources and phylogenomic backgrounds.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: Paper describes phylogenomic grouping; accession-level supplement still needs extraction.
studies.next_action: Download supplementary files and check whether isolate IDs, MIC_CHX values, clades, and genome accessions are in one recoverable table.
studies.caution: Good size, but not model-ready until public genome accessions are confirmed.

studies.organism_role: hospital-associated opportunist; related to VRE surveillance context
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Article reports chlorhexidine MIC heterogeneity and clonal-lineage associations.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: Genomic evolution focus; accession-level linkage must be verified from supplements.
studies.next_action: Inspect supplements for isolate-level MIC_CHX and public genome identifiers.
studies.caution: Likely more useful as external validation/context unless isolate count and accessions are strong.

studies.organism_role: wet hospital environment; strong bridge toward pharmaceutical water risk prioritization
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Preprint describes supplementary Table S4 with ARGs, CHX MICs, taxonomic assignments, and sample metadata.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: Raw WGS data reported under PRJNA1169385 and source code on GitHub.
studies.next_action: Check whether GitHub/supplement contains a machine-readable Table S4 and whether PRJNA1169385 is public.
studies.caution: Preprint status and data-release timing make this unsuitable as a core benchmark until data are actually accessible.

studies.citation_short: Webber et al. 2021, Applied and Environmental Microbiology
studies.organism_role: water-associated opportunists; relevant to Pseudomonas pharma-water organisms
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Table 1 reports isolate-level triclosan-related phenotypes and genotypes.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: Study performed WGS for all isolates; supplemental scripts/data reported.
studies.next_action: Extract Table 1 and supplementary genome accessions; use only as external case study if n remains ~30.
studies.caution: Too small for a strong second benchmark; useful for mechanism-oriented transfer testing.

studies.organism_group: Mixed food-industry drain isolates from 24 genera
studies.organism_role: industrial wet environment; food/pharma sanitation analogy
studies.endpoint: Benzalkonium chloride MIC and biofilm survival/regrowth after biocide exposure
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Study used 31 WGS bacterial isolates; abstract reports BC MIC context and viable-survivor/biofilm outcomes.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: BioProject PRJNA1194757 reported for sequencing/metagenomic data.
studies.next_action: Verify whether the 31 isolate genomes and isolate-level BC MICs are public and linkable.
studies.caution: Small and mixed-species; better for external screening than training.

studies.organism_role: skin/clinical isolates; chlorhexidine and QAC decolonization relevance
studies.endpoint: F10SC, benzalkonium-containing QAC, and chlorhexidine tolerance
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Phenotypic biocide tolerance tested in a subset of 31 isolates.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: Article states all isolates underwent WGS/MLST, but accession availability needs verification.
studies.next_action: Recover original article/supplement and verify isolate-level tolerance plus WGS accession mapping.
studies.caution: Likely underpowered and may not have clean public accession links.

studies.organism_group: E. faecalis, E. faecium, E. coli, P. aeruginosa, A. baumannii
studies.organism_role: clinical veterinary opportunists; includes multiple water/hospital-relevant species
studies.endpoint: BZK, chlorhexidine, polyhexanide, and octenidine MICs
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Paper reports species-level MIC distributions for 49 E. faecalis, 37 E. faecium, 59 E. coli, 56 P. aeruginosa, and 14 A. baumannii isolates.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: No public WGS linkage identified from the article-level evidence.
studies.next_action: Inspect supplements for row-level MICs; if only distributions are public, cite as ECOFF/context evidence.
studies.caution: Large phenotyped panel, but aggregate distributions and missing genomes probably block supervised ML.

studies.citation_short: Labuschagne et al. 2020, Microbiology Resource Announcements
studies.organism_role: isolated from DDAC disinfectant bottle; direct disinfectant-contamination relevance
studies.endpoint: QAC MICs including BZK and DDAC
studies.row_level_label_evidence: Table reports MICs for resistant Serratia HRI and type-strain comparator.
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: HRI genome deposited under PRJNA580358; BioSample SAMN13155787; SRA and assembly accessions reported.
studies.next_action: Use as qualitative validation/control for QAC-region screening, not model training.

studies.organism_role: model organism; mechanistic adaptation to periodic disinfection
studies.genome_linkage_evidence: WGS data deposited under PRJNA735069; reference NC_000913.3/GCF_000005845.2.
studies.next_action: Use for robustness/adaptation discussion, not population-level supervised ML.
studies.caution: Adapted-lineage labels are not equivalent to independent isolate tolerance labels.
